column3: Activity steps between profileable entries in the loaded feed; BootUI's LiveActivityTest.opens the request profile an HTTP Exchanges link names covers profile opening, while stepping is a sharpit UI adaptation.
The request profile is inline in sharpit's Activity panel, so BootUI's drawer width toggle and drawer section tabs have no corresponding container.
BootUI's highlights and work breakdown require journal authorization, baseline, REST, and ORM fields that sharpit's RequestProfile DTO does not expose.
Uses sharpit's existing GET /http-exchanges/routes ranking DTO and route-filtered GET /http-exchanges; the route drawer uses a native dialog and the existing paged table.
sharpit has no Runtime Insights panel or observation DTO to filter, group, or pivot.
sharpit's UI has no button-shaped navigation anchors; navigation uses plain anchors and actions use buttons.
